ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ANLON Healthcare Limited has submitted a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This confirms that the company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFIN Technologies Limited, has furnished all required details concerning dematerialized and rematerialized securities to the respective stock exchanges. The filing indicates ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements for investor services and maintaining accurate electronic share records, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
